replace-rig-core.description: Replace rig-core with custom LLM abstraction layer - eliminate patched fork dependency, reduce compile surface by ~90%, gain full control over provider HTTP clients, streaming SSE parsing, multi-turn agent loop, and tool trait

hierarchical-compaction.title: CMPCT
hierarchical-compaction.description: Hierarchical Lossless Context Compaction — Replace expensive batch LLM compaction with zero-marginal-cost agent-driven DAG construction using /clear + SessionSearch + inject_summary. Three-layer architecture: Layer 0 (structurally lossless trimming), Layer 1 (in-view DAG construction), Layer 2 (emergency threshold safety net). Research foundation: CMV, LCM, Focus, ACON, HiAgent, SimpleMem, H-MEM.

knowledge-graph.title: Nanograph-Powered Knowledge Graph
knowledge-graph.description: Embedded nanograph property graph database for building relational memory across all agent sessions. Enables concept extraction, decision tracking, and graph-based search over conversation history.

provider-resilience.title: Provider and stream loop resilience improvements

local-change-protocols.title: Local Change Protocols
local-change-protocols.description: Embedded file-level governance rules that control how high-risk code may be changed. Inspired by Protocol-Driven Development (PDD) patterns. Classifies code by risk zones, embeds binding constraints directly in source files, and enforces them through hooks and validation.

zai-glm-performance.title: Z.AI GLM Provider Performance & Quality Improvements
zai-glm-performance.description: Improvements to fspec's Z.AI GLM provider integration for better tool-calling accuracy, reasoning support, and runtime configurability. Based on analysis of the official GLM-5 reference repository.

session-header-review.title: SessionHeader & sessionStore Critical Review Fixes
session-header-review.description: Address code quality, DRY violations, dead code, test quality, and state management issues identified in the SessionHeader critical review report (REPORT.md). 10 critical issues investigated by 3 parallel agents — 9 confirmed, 1 refuted (C4 ANSI injection).

context-window-unification.title: Unified Context Window and Configurable Compaction Thresholds
context-window-unification.description: Establish Rust as the single source of truth for context window size across all models, and make compaction thresholds independently configurable per-model (absolute tokens or percentage of context window). Currently, the TUI sources context_window from models.dev in TypeScript while Rust has its own resolution chain — they can disagree (e.g., models.dev says 1M for Opus 4.6 but the API actually limits to 200k without the beta header). Additionally, compaction thresholds are mathematically coupled to context_window with no per-model override capability. This epic decouples display context window from compaction trigger threshold and ensures both flow from a single authority in Rust.

model-limits-resolution.title: Centralised Model Limits Resolution
model-limits-resolution.description: Centralise model limits resolution (context_window, max_output_tokens, compaction_threshold) into a single SOLID architecture that gives providers veto authority over external registries. Replaces the broken CTX-005 approach where models.dev unconditionally overrides provider constants.

custom-provider-tui-wiring.title: Custom Rhai Provider - End-to-End TUI Wiring
custom-provider-tui-wiring.description: Wire custom Rhai providers through every surface: shared Rust fspec_home() helper, extended NAPI (discovery paths, file enumeration, re-scan, model limits), Rust-sourced provider registry in TypeScript (replace hard-coded SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS), ProviderSettingsScreen rendering of custom providers, Model Selector integration, slash commands (/provider init/list/test/edit), and init scaffolding with Rhai script templates. Rust is the single source of truth for all provider state - TypeScript is a pure view.

scriptable-subscription-providers.title: Scriptable Subscription Providers via Rhai
scriptable-subscription-providers.description: Duplicate Claude Code and Codex subscription flows as Rhai-driven custom providers so the current hardcoded ClaudeProvider and CodexProvider eventually become one of several interchangeable transports. This epic delivers the Rhai surface (OAuth, reasoning deltas, multimodal, thinking_config, real rig::Agent construction) plus shipped parity scripts. Deprecation/removal of the hardcoded providers is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE — they continue to ship alongside the scripted versions.

rust-frontend.title: Distributed Rust Frontend (tarpc + ratatui)
rust-frontend.description: Distributed Rust frontend: tarpc-over-WebSocket service exposing the codelet/NAPI surface, plus a ratatui client with dual transport (in-process embedded OR remote WebSocket). Replaces the Ink/React TUI incrementally while leaving the TypeScript+NAPI stack fully operational.

rust-cli-port.title: Port fspec CLI commands to a Rust crate
rust-cli-port.description: Port the ~190 fspec commands (~48,200 LOC of TypeScript) into a Rust crate inside the codelet/ workspace. Goal: a `fspec-core` crate that owns all the business logic (work-unit state machine, Example Mapping, Gherkin generation, dependency graph, hooks, persistence, validators, migrations) so that both the existing TS CLI (via NAPI shim) and a future pure-Rust CLI binary can share a single source of truth. Complements the rust-frontend epic — together they enable a fully Rust fspec while keeping the TS stack operational throughout migration.
